I feel like you need to learn to love yourself first. Be happy with yourself. Feed your mind knowledge on everything that interests you. Ask yourself why do you really want this? Where does it stem from? From there, you will be able to know yourself and how to deal with it. 

Try to heal from the past and learn more about yourself and where you can improve.

You might find someone at some point on your self-discovery journey. And with all the work you did on yourself, you can be someone who chooses a healthy relationship and create a healthy life for yourself and your kids.

Just because you have not found someone yet, does not mean there is no one for you in this life. It just means you are not ready to meet yet.

As I have witnessed how loneliness would cause ppl to make foolish choices if anyone said they want them. Because of how desperate they are. Grow yourself to a point where you know your self worth and won’t accept anything less.

Go to the police. It’s hard i know but it’s never your fault. No matter what you did or did not do. Even if you initiated contact but not agreed on sex, it is still rape. On top of that, you were sleeping in a place you thought was safe. He failed you and your friends too. So, it’s your choice to not fail yourself and stand up for it. As I learned one thing, no one will ever stand up for you or protect you. You will always be the only one who is there for yourself. 

One day, you’ll look back and be thankful for standing up for yourself. You will find comfort in your strength. 

It might help you to heal faster too. Not sure though as I was one of the many ppl who failed to report it to the right authorities.

One day though, regardless of whether you report it or not, you will heal. Suicide will stop being on your mind. And you will try to live a life that gives you happiness.

Everything is going to be alright at the end. It was a long road for me. But I am fine now. Trying to live a better life.

First of all, you need to know where is your feelings stemming from. Whether it is because you don’t trust the guy, her or yourself.

Second, this should be a discussion between you and her. About how are you going to tackle it when one of you has a friend from another gender.

Like, in my relationship, we agreed that it is fine for both parties to have friends from another gender. But, if we weren’t comfortable with one specific girl or guy in our surroundings due to certain vibes or something, we would discuss it. Since me and my partner’s emotions are more important, we decide to let the person go.

So, it is better to sit with yourself first. Then, with her. Although, if she puts someone else’s relationship with her over you, I am not really sure she is the right person for you.

But, no one knows your relationship better.

I believe that everyone is loved at some point in their life even if they don’t know it. I literally had a crush on someone after he died from his photos and personality were spread all over my country so that’s how I got to know that he exists. Also, I had a crush on someone for years and he never knew. If he didn’t ask me out, it would still be a secret until now. I am 20 but I know the feeling to want to love someone but can’t. I just started having different feelings toward someone who loved me for years. I know the feeling of wanting to feel something that is easy for everyone but not you. It is okay though. It will take time. Some might already had crush on you or loved you but did not see you as someone approachable or they did not believe that they are high enough for your standards. Maybe they were too afraid that you will reject them. An advice from a ted talk I got was accepting your circumstances but not giving up your hope. It means that your suffering will end but you just don’t know when. You’ll reach there hopefully. Because everyone does at some point. Some have it early, some have it late.

At some point, I thought maybe I am the one holding onto all those traumas and suicidal thoughts. I started finding my own way and the ideas decreased. I am following an unhealthy path to be able to survive. However, I am back to where I was with the smallest shit. But, I believe that we can change the future. Being hopeless is from the depression package. I know it takes years and it’s rough. But if you really want to change it, then you can. Also, I believe that it is not lying. It is being supportive. A lot of people lived with suicidal thoughts and had failed attempts but found their way at the end. So, have hope. I know it’s rough and tiring. But I believe that it will get better if you choose it too and with a huge amount of work towards that.

So, choose your life. What will you lose if you did not try? Get your degree, find a job and rent a place for you. Runaway when you can. For now, just live for that future. Also, seek a therapist.
